title: Working Library - Model Progression

entries.name: Concept stage
entries.primary_purpose: design intent, massing, key systems/options and feasibility

entries.name: Design Development stage
entries.primary_purpose: refine systems, define interfaces and establish coordination-ready intent
minimum_information: system metadata sufficient for clash rules

entries.name: Coordination stage
entries.primary_purpose: resolve inter-discipline conflicts to a declared confidence level

entries.name: Fabrication stage
entries.primary_purpose: enable shop drawing, CAM/CNC, procurement and offsite assembly where applicable

entries.name: As-built / record stage
entries.primary_purpose: capture installed conditions and approved deviations for record and operations

working_rules: Do not use a model beyond its declared progression stage and authorized uses without an explicit risk/authority decision.
Information milestones should test the declared stage criteria before release.
Exact stage names, responsibilities and element requirements may be refined by the project BEP.
This record is working guidance, not a substitute for an applicable contractual LOD/LOI requirement.

provenance.migration_note: Stage-based model progression guidance retained as non-authoritative working knowledge; source organization names and role assignments generalized.
